stackDivergence.rationale: Original source ownership and consumed native contracts are retained; host references, immutable XML/URI UTF16 fields and asynchronous ZIP transport bind browser execution around actual existing typed Any/OUString/PropertyValue owners.

preservedResponsibilities: Consumed generic URI value operations preserve lexical UTF16 and absent versus empty authority/query/fragment. Component service identity, mutex/native lifetime and unused URI methods are omitted.
omittedResponsibilities: Whole native module interfaces/ABI and unconsumed responsibilities are not claimed.
DOCX full model import/export, shell and UI integration remain in progress in V4DQJW.
